title: Thai Shrimp Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-inspired stir fry made with succulent shrimp, crunchy vegetables, and aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink and cooked through, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the shrimp from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced red onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles, soy sauce, and Thai chili to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Return the cooked shrimp to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil and cook for 30 seconds.
